easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Everglades.
When Everglades enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Everglades.
Resolve the Everglades trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Everglades from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
